name: @projexlight/telemetry
summary: Structured logging + Prom-style metric primitives for every SDK + service. Wraps pino + prom-client behind a uniform API so service code never imports the underlying libs directly — swapping backends is a single-package change.

hooks.name: logger
hooks.description: Per-module logger; pre-configured with structured fields + trace correlation.

hooks.name: counter
hooks.description: Get-or-create a prom counter for a metric.

hooks.name: histogram
hooks.description: Get-or-create a prom histogram for a metric.

hooks.name: scrapeMetrics
hooks.description: Render metrics in Prometheus exposition format for /metrics endpoint.

scenarios.title: Per-SDK logger inherits trace-id context
scenarios.when_to_use: Every SDK call inside a request — logger() returns a child with trace_id + sdk_name pre-filled.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Log lines have consistent structured fields. Search by trace_id walks the whole request.

scenarios.title: Per-SDK counter + histogram
scenarios.when_to_use: SDK records its own metrics — counter increments per call, histogram captures latency.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Metrics scraped by Prom + visible in Grafana. No double-registration on hot reload.

scenarios.title: Render /metrics endpoint
scenarios.when_to_use: Every service exposes GET /metrics; this hook renders the current state.
scenarios.example_code:
import { scrapeMetrics } from '@projexlight/telemetry';
app.get('/metrics', async () => scrapeMetrics());
scenarios.expected_outcome: Prometheus scrapes successfully. Histogram buckets pre-configured for the SLO targets.

compliance_posture.notes: Structured logging is the SOC2-CC7.2 monitoring artifact. PII auto-redacted via the configured redact paths so logs are safe for retention.
